dreamsnaps.title: Resort Realms
dreamsnaps.description: Vacation in the ultimate resort in any setting you choose! Design a New Orleans paradise with Tiana, a desert oasis with Aladdin and Jasmine, or a galactic space haven with Buzz and Stitch.

dreamsnaps.title: Good or Evil?
dreamsnaps.description: Will you embrace virtue like Aurora or succumb to darkness like Maleficent? Show us the battle between good and evil within! Decorate and dress to show two parallel paths, and choose which aesthetic defines you.

dreamsnaps.title: Fall Harvest
dreamsnaps.description: Celebrate the season's bounty! Are you gathering cursed crops or the plumpest of pumpkins? Show off autumnal garden chic with your style and decor.

dreamsnaps.title: Dreamlight Detective
dreamsnaps.description: Dress as a detective solving magical mysteries! Investigate the scene, interview suspects, and piece together clues. Can you solve the case?

dreamsnaps.title: Forest Folk
dreamsnaps.description: Are you a tree spirit, a fairy like Tinker Bell, or a bayou queen like Mama Odie? Decorate and dress to celebrate your magical connection with nature, showing off greenery and enchantment!

dreamsnaps.title: Twisted Fairy Tale
dreamsnaps.description: Put your unique spin on storybook charm! Reimagine your favorite fairy tale with enchanting costumes and dazzling decorations that put a new twist on an old story.

dreamsnaps.title: Malevolent Majesty
dreamsnaps.description: Channel gothic royalty with a stunning outfit and dark decor. Rule over a haunted Halloween Realm like Jack and Sally, or command your kingdom like the Evil Queen.

dreamsnaps.title: Shapeshift Superstar
dreamsnaps.description: Embrace a magical transformation! Channel your inner shapeshifter like Maui, or transform like the Beast. Build a scene where change sparks wonder!

dreamsnaps.title: Wayfinder's Isle
dreamsnaps.description: Join Moana on a wayfinding adventure! Decorate your Valley like Motunui. Capture a sunlit island day or starlit night with glowing paths, sparkling waters, and tropical wonders.

dreamsnaps.title: Routine's Return
dreamsnaps.description: Style a vibrant scene celebrating the return to routine and summer's end. Capture a moment at work like Mike and Sulley, at school like Pinocchio, or at home prepping your next move!

dreamsnaps.title: Postcard Summer
dreamsnaps.description: It's time for your annual summer getaway. Are you heading to the countryside for a stay in your ranch, unwinding in your seaside mansion, or sharing canapés in your best friend's downtown penthouse?

dreamsnaps.title: Flashback Vibes
dreamsnaps.description: Create a colorful, energetic scene inspired by early 2000s pop culture. Dress to shine and show off your personality! How will you capture the spirit of Y2K glamour?

dreamsnaps.title: Getting Artsy
dreamsnaps.description: Create an artist's workshop where creativity flows free! Show off sculpted pieces, sew magical outfits, or paint enchanting works like Rapunzel. Express yourself!

dreamsnaps.title: Eco-Friendly Fun
dreamsnaps.description: It's a harmonious day in an eco-friendly paradise! Create a sustainable Valley, with serene spots and mindful touches. Build a brighter, greener, future - just like WALL-E and EVE.
